basics.name: Shaoqian Zhou
basics.label: PhD Student
basics.summary: PhD student in Electrical and Computer Engineering at the University of Michigan, with research interests in computer architecture, high-performance processor and accelerator design.

work.name: WaveEdge
highlights: Performance benchmark and bottleneck analysis of open-source RISC-V vector units on common AI/HPC kernels
Develop a Gem5 performance model for a RISC-V RoCC dataflow accelerator, based on open-source high-perf CPU core
Design RISC-V ISA extensions and develop kernels for the dataflow accelerator, achieving 3~20% performance improvement on common workloads under similar power and area when compared to vector units

work.name: Chinese University of Hong Kong
highlights: Develop a ML (RL+GNN) framework for automated PPA estimation and optimization of HLS-based accelerator design
Achieve 5-10% PPA improvements against default algorithms and superior ADRS when compared to results obtained from PPO, on FPGA accelerators designed for Polybench, with minimized runtime overhead

work.name: Canopus Networks
highlights: Develop eBPF C program for network traffic monitoring and packet processing inside Linux kernel

work.name: Arista Networks
highlights: Design RTL modules with I2C/PCIe interfaces for testing FPGA runtime monitoring and debugging tool
Test a newly designed register file model and its compatibility with PCIe

publications.name: GFNBinding: Performance-driven High-level Synthesis Binding based on Multi-Objective GFlowNets
publications.summary: Pengjia Li, Shaoqian Zhou, et al.

projects.name: High Performance Data Cache for Vortex GPGPU
highlights: Integrate high-performance data cache IP into Vortex GPU's cache subsystem RTL and achieve up to 7% GPU IPC uplift on AI/HPC kernels under various GPU/cache configurations
Integrate a hardware stride prefetcher into L2 cache and achieve 8~15% miss rates reduction
Analyze cache subsystem bottleneck and limitations and implement/propose architectural solutions to address them
Contribute to HPDcache project on its micro-architecture improvements and architectural features

projects.name: RISC-V & MIPS Pipeline Processors
highlights: RTL implementation of classical 5-stages MIPS-Lite processor and 32-bit RISC-V (RV32I) processor
Custom schematic design of ALU, SRAM and regfile using NCSU 45nm FreePDK

projects.name: VLSI Circuit Design
highlights: Design a pipelined multiplier-accumulation (MACC) unit using 130nm PDK that runs at 1GHz
Design a 1 GHz clock distribution tree with 100ps rise-time and low jitter/skew

projects.name: X16R Hash Accelerator
highlights: Design an FPGA accelerator for X16R hashing algorithms leveraging high level synthesis and dynamic reconfiguration
Implement the full X16R hash chain on a single VCK5000 card and achieve up to 6 times less kernel switch overhead
